query: Help us map our team members, their current skills and capabilities, what they are interested in learning, and which projects from our work inventory they are assigned to.
Build a work tracker linking our staff to active initiatives and operational duties, and generate an Excel CSV plus Mermaid visuals of everyone's workload.
Check our team's project assignments for single-point-of-failure bottlenecks and see whose growth interests match our branch capability gaps.
Draft a high-level 5-year vision statement and operating principles for the branch.
Capture a raw unapproved idea from a stakeholder workshop into the idea inventory.
Configure an Azure AI Foundry agent deployment.
